properties.site-address: Wixams New Settlement LPH14 H31, Wixams (Land Focused on the Elstow Storage Depot)
properties.notes: Delivery of the site is likely to continue beyond 2022.. Built development consisting of building and engineering works for a mixed use development of residential, employment, retail (A1, A2, A3) leisure and community uses, open space and associated uses together with supporting infrastructure (roads, paths, cycleways, pumping stations, electricity substations), public transport, interchange and car parking (1261 units still to be completed).
